 This Petition Coming On For Orders, Through
Physical Hearing/Video Conferencing This Day, The
Court Made The Following:
 Order
1.

It is seen that an alternative remedy under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and
Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 is available to the
petition
. In the light of the same, reserving liberty to the petitioners to approach the appropriate Authority in accordance with law, the present writ petition is hereby dismissed.
2. It is needless to state that the petitioners are also at liberty to give a representation to the concerned NC: 2024:KHC:6072 Authorities, if the law so permits.
